entities.name: Aspartate 1-decarboxylase
observations: The 139-aa query exactly matches reviewed Mycobacterium bovis UniProt reference P65661 across the full sequence (100% identity and coverage).
Curated annotation: pyruvoyl-dependent decarboxylation of L-aspartate to beta-alanine; EC 4.1.1.11, Rhea RHEA:19497.
Reported cofactor is a covalently bound pyruvoyl group; pathway context is beta-alanine production for pantothenate biosynthesis.
